purpose: Stress-test proposition-level legal genealogy when one temporary emergency act produces divergent rule fates during transition to a permanent framework.

handoff_timing.warning: A directive transposition deadline is not itself a national application-start assertion.

official_bridge_evidence.observation: The Commission proposal expressly declines to prolong Article 3(1) because the same presumption is contained in Directive (EU) 2023/2413.
The final extension regulation states that some measures introduced by Regulation (EU) 2022/2577 were included in Directive 2018/2001 through Directive (EU) 2023/2413.

rule_fates.caution: This establishes rule genealogy, not identity of legal instrument or automatic continuity of domestic application.

rule_fates.target_anchor: Directive (EU) 2018/2001 permanent permitting provisions as amended by Directive (EU) 2023/2413

official_bridge_evidence.observation: The emergency repowering rule is prolonged in narrowed scope while permanent RED III permitting deadlines apply outside the emergency-designated areas.

rule_fates.caution: Coexistence is not promotion: the emergency rule retains a bounded legal identity while the permanent framework applies alongside it.

rule_fates.target_anchor: Directive (EU) 2018/2001 renewables acceleration-area framework as amended by Directive (EU) 2023/2413

official_bridge_evidence.observation: The legislature says Article 6 can and should coexist for a limited period with the permanent renewables acceleration-area framework because designation under the permanent regime takes longer.

rule_fates.caution: The bridge exists because implementation timing differs; it is not evidence that the temporary and permanent rules are semantically identical.

official_bridge_evidence.observation: Both create accelerated solar-equipment permitting rules, including a three-month ceiling for installations on artificial structures.

rule_fates.caution: Close subject matter and wording do not by themselves justify DIRECT proposition lineage.

official_bridge_evidence.observation: Both establish accelerated heat-pump permitting and grid-connection treatment with related capacity thresholds.

rule_fates.caution: No provision-specific official statement equivalent to the Article 3(1) bridge has been pinned in this discovery.

architecture_result.statement: A single emergency instrument can have multiple rule fates. Needle should model promotion, temporary coexistence and derived analogy at proposition level rather than assign one successor relation to the whole act.
forbidden_shortcuts: One temporary source act implies one successor regime or one shared fate for all provisions.
A textually close permanent provision proves DIRECT rule lineage.
Temporary coexistence with a permanent framework means the two rules are identical.
The 1 July 2024 RED III transposition deadline proves uninterrupted national application from that date.
Non-extension of an emergency provision proves it disappeared substantively.
